faq.question: Q1. What is the NHSRC Consultant - Android Developer (Short Term) recruitment?
faq.answer: It is a short-term consultancy recruitment by the National Health Systems Resource Centre under the IT Division for 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant - Android Developer (Short Term) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NHSRC Consultant - Android Developer (Short Term)?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving applications is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.E./M.Tech. degree from a recognized university or institution along with 8 years or more of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is up to 45 years as on the date of receiving the application.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NHSRC Consultant - Android Developer (Short Term)?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the NHSRC Consultant - Android Developer (Short Term) position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by filling out the prescribed online application format available on the NHSRC website.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the shortlisting of candidates, potential written tests, and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly remuneration for this post?
faq.answer: The remuneration ranges between Rs. 1,00,000/- to Rs. 1,25,000/- per month, commensurate with qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The work location is New Delhi with a willingness to travel on a need basis.
